subject: Tomorrow is Master's Mahasamadhi - Remember with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we honor the anniversary of Paramhansa Yogananda's mahasamadhi - his conscious exit from the body on March 7, 1952.

Master's mahasamadhi was a profound demonstration of his mastery over life and death. His body remained incorruptible for weeks, showing the power of divine realization. This day reminds us of the eternal nature of the soul and the possibility of conscious union with God.

As we remember this sacred event, we can reflect on Master's teachings about death, the soul's journey, and the ultimate goal of self-realization.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

We hope this day deepens your understanding of the eternal nature of the soul.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
